'''Cockroach workers''' are found in the [[Stronghold of Player Safety]]. They are good [[non-member]] monsters for mid-levelled players to train on. They also drop [[Crimson charm]]s quite often, making the Stronghold a popular place to obtain charms for training [[Summoning]].

They can hit 50s and 60s very often if [[Rune equipment|Rune armour]] or better is not worn. As they occupy 2 {{x}} 2 areas, rangers and mages may fight them in safe spots in Level 5 of the Stronghold. Two cockroach workers have their spawn points enclosed in a small room with an exit only one tile wide so they cannot attack a player fighting them with a Range or Magic attack style from outside of the room. However, workers' defences are rather high, making it harder for low and mid-level players to deal damage to it. For [[members]], a [[halberd]] can be used for safe [[Melee]] training, as it can attack up to two spaces away from the player, allowing you to strike melee attacks without getting hit.

Many players take free food from the [[Gunnarsgrunn|nearby fishing spot]] when training on cockroaches.

Also the Monastery is nearby for healing or using the altar (level 31 prayer needed).

Medium-levelled players will sometimes kill this monster for their decent stackable drops on free worlds, and for their relatively good crimson charm drop rate for their level. If you have a decent combat level +70s, you can gain up to 40 Crimson charm per hour. +90s would produce roughly 60 charms per hour.
